questions.question: Describe the procedure for sealing and labeling physical evidence.
questions.solution_html:
• Sealing and Labeling Evidence:
  • Place evidence in primary container (paper bindle/bag); seal with tamper-evident tape. (1.5
  • Marks) Label with case number, date, item description, and investigator's signature across the seal.
  • (1.5 Marks)

questions.question: Explain why glass fragments travel opposite to the direction of force.
questions.solution_html:
• Glass Fragments Movement:
  • Explanation of radial and concentric fractures. (1 Mark)
  • Elasticity causes glass to spring back; "backscatter" or "back spatter" occurs when fragments are
  • ejected toward the force. (2 Marks)

questions.question: Explain the role of weathering in soil formation.
questions.solution_html:
• Weathering in Soil Formation:
  • Physical weathering: Breakdown of rocks via temperature/pressure. (1 Mark)
  • Chemical weathering: Alteration of minerals via water/oxygen. (1 Mark)
  • Forensic significance: Creates unique mineral profiles. (1 Mark)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain forensic examination of electrical installations
questions.solution_html:
• Forensic Examination of Electrical Installations:
  • Checking for arcing, short circuits, or overloaded circuits. (1.5 Marks)
  • Examination of fuses, circuit breakers, and "beading" on wires to determine fire origin. (1.5 Marks)
